descriptions.w3d_d30e_load_tga_resource_801b44f8: Loads a texture resource from a file: opens the file through the file service (slot 4), reads its size via slot 7 into a stat record, creates a buffer entry of that size, reads the file into it, and for a tga extension decodes through the codec service 0x804165e0 into a new object of type 0x80364fa4, then stores the object through out and its name string at +36. Returns the failure code of the reads or 0x80004005.
